name: contextEngine
description: Context Engine — an OSS toolkit for groups
author: Context Engine Contributors

scripts.chain:start: anvil --silent --port 8545 --chain-id 31337 --mnemonic "test test test test test test test test test test test junk"
scripts.chain:deploy: forge build && node scripts/sync-abis.mjs && forge script foundry/script/DeployLocal.s.sol --tc DeployLocal --rpc-url http://127.0.0.1:8545 --broadcast --sender 0xf39fd6e51aad88f6f4ce6ab8827279cfffb92266 --unlocked
scripts.test:contracts: bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; if [ ! -d node_modules/@openzeppelin/contracts ]; then echo "Error: @openzeppelin/contracts not found. Run npm install first."; exit 1; fi; forge test --match-contract "^(SurveysTest|CustomSBTTest|SessionRegistryTest|SurveysFuzzTest|CustomSBTFuzzTest|SessionRegistryFuzzTest|CustomSBTInvariantTest)$"'
scripts.test:wiring: node scripts/verify-test-wiring.js && node scripts/verify-test-inventory.js && npm run -s client-boundaries:check && npm run -s dead-exports:check && npm run -s test:hygiene && node --test scripts/client-large-file-inventory.test.js
scripts.test:ci: npm run test:wiring && npm run type-debt:check && npm run verify:release && npm run test:contracts && npm run test:client && npm run coverage-floor:check && npm run test:root:jest && npm run test:worker:session-cors && npm run test:cc && npm run test:node && npm run test:cache-guard
scripts.test:e2e:quick:stability: bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; RUNS=${E2E_STABILITY_RUNS:-3}; for i in $(seq 1 "$RUNS"); do echo "stability run $i/$RUNS"; npm run -s test:e2e:quick; done'
scripts.tests: npm run test:ci && npm run test:surveys-sbt
scripts.test:local: bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; anvil --silent --port 8545 --chain-id 31337 --mnemonic "test test test test test test test test test test test junk" > /tmp/anvil.log 2>&1 & ANVIL_PID=$!; trap "kill $ANVIL_PID" EXIT; for i in {1..20}; do if cast block-number --rpc-url http://127.0.0.1:8545 >/dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi; sleep 0.25; done; npm run chain:deploy; (cd client && npm test)'
scripts.test:surveys-sbt: bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; if [ ! -f client/src/utilities/web3/contractScripts.surveys-sbt.proxy.test.js ]; then echo "Skipping test:surveys-sbt: client proxy test is not present in this checkout."; exit 0; fi; anvil --silent --port 8545 --chain-id 31337 --mnemonic "test test test test test test test test test test test junk" > /tmp/anvil.log 2>&1 & ANVIL_PID=$!; trap "kill $ANVIL_PID" EXIT; for i in {1..20}; do if cast block-number --rpc-url http://127.0.0.1:8545 >/dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi; sleep 0.25; done; npm run chain:deploy; (cd client && NODE_PATH="$PWD/node_modules" CE_RUN_LOCAL_CHAIN_TESTS=1 CI=1 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/utilities/web3/contractScripts.surveys-sbt.proxy.test.js)'
scripts.verify:release: npm run lint && npm run typecheck:client && npm run -s test:node:tracked && npm run test:release:client && npm run verify:public-release-surface && npm run worker:bundle && npm run verify:worker-bundle && npm --prefix client run build
